content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Senior Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST), located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Senior Project Engineer under a project-based research opening funded by BIRAC.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Project Engineer position reserved under the EWS category.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for this role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering followed by an M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, along with relevant desirable design and modeling skills.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years as per the guidelines laid out in the official recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Project Engineer post will receive a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for SCTIMST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via a Walk-In interview process. Candidates do not need to submit any prior online applications.

faq.question: Q8. When is the Walk-In-Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-In-Interview for the Senior Project Engineer position is scheduled to take place on 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled Recruitment Report Form, bio-data, original and self-attested copies of age, qualification, and experience certificates, plus a valid Income and Asset certificate.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of the institute?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the institute at www.sctimst.ac.in to get detailed notifications and further updates regarding the interview venue and timing.
